questions.question: Who became the first Indian to win an individual Olympic gold medal?
questions.explanation: Abhinav Bindra won India's first individual Olympic gold medal at the 2008 Beijing Olympics in the 10m Air Rifle event, ending India's 108-year wait for an individual gold.

questions.question: The 2028 Summer Olympics will be held in which city?
questions.explanation: The 2028 Summer Olympics will be held in Los Angeles, USA. It will be the third time LA hosts the Olympics, having previously hosted in 1932 and 1984.

questions.question: Which country has won the most FIFA World Cup titles?
questions.explanation: Brazil has won the FIFA World Cup a record 5 times (1958, 1962, 1970, 1994, 2002). Brazil is the only country to have participated in every FIFA World Cup.

questions.question: The Arjuna Award is given for outstanding achievement in which field?
questions.explanation: The Arjuna Award is given by the Government of India for outstanding achievement in sports. It was instituted in 1961 and is the second-highest sporting honor in India.

questions.question: P.V. Sindhu won her first Olympic medal at which Games?
questions.explanation: P.V. Sindhu won a silver medal in badminton at the 2016 Rio Olympics, becoming the first Indian woman to win an Olympic silver medal. She also won bronze at Tokyo 2020.

questions.question: The Durand Cup is associated with which sport?
questions.explanation: The Durand Cup is one of the oldest football tournaments in the world, established in 1888 by Sir Henry Mortimer Durand in India. It is played annually by Indian football clubs.

questions.question: In which year did India win its last Cricket World Cup?
questions.explanation: India won the ICC Cricket World Cup in 2011 under the captaincy of MS Dhoni, defeating Sri Lanka in the final at Mumbai's Wankhede Stadium.

questions.question: The Khel Ratna Award is India's highest sporting honor. It was renamed to 'Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award' in:
questions.explanation: The Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award was renamed to Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award in August 2021, honoring India's greatest hockey player on his birth anniversary.

questions.question: Which Indian chess player became the youngest World Chess Champion in history?
questions.explanation: D. Gukesh became the youngest ever undisputed World Chess Champion in December 2024 at age 18, defeating Ding Liren of China in Singapore.

questions.question: Thomas Cup and Uber Cup are associated with which sport?
questions.explanation: Thomas Cup is the men's world team badminton championship and Uber Cup is the women's equivalent. Both are organized by BWF (Badminton World Federation).

questions.question: Neeraj Chopra's gold medal at Tokyo Olympics 2020 was in which event?
questions.explanation: Neeraj Chopra won gold in Javelin Throw at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics with a throw of 87.58m, becoming the first Indian to win an Olympic gold in an athletics event.

questions.question: The 2024 Paris Olympics saw India win how many medals?
questions.explanation: India won 6 medals at Paris 2024 Olympics: 1 silver (Neeraj Chopra - Javelin), 5 bronze (Manu Bhaker x2, Sarabjot Singh, Swapnil Kusale, Indian Hockey team, Aman Sehrawat).
